integrity: The proof partitions functions by the number of parts that contain label 2 and checks the two defining neighborhood conditions exactly in each regime. A separate exhaustive checker tests the definition directly for every complete multipartite isomorphism type through order nine and compares every polynomial coefficient.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The minimum-value corollary is substantially covered by published general characterizations; the new content is the all-function classification and weight enumerator.
Finite exhaustive verification through order nine is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed prior enumerative work.
title: Quasi-total Roman weight enumerator of complete multipartite graphs
